name: vscode-clone
description: VSCode Clone is a modern desktop code editor built with Vue 3, Vite, and Electron, designed to replicate the core experience of a lightweight development environment. Powered by the Monaco Editor (the same editor used in Visual Studio Code), it delivers a fast, responsive, and familiar coding interface directly on the desktop. The application leverages Electron to package a web-based frontend into a cross-platform desktop app, combining the flexibility of web technologies with native system access. The project uses a modular architecture with Vite for fast builds and hot module replacement, TypeScript for type safety, and Electron Builder for seamless packaging and distribution, with additional features such as custom icons, OS checks, and optimized asset handling ensuring a smooth and consistent user experience.

scripts.build: npm run prepare:build && npm run icon:png && npm run os:check && vue-tsc && vite build && electron-builder && npm run licence
scripts.prepare:build: del release /S /Q && rmdir release /S /Q && mkdir release && echo done
scripts.clean: del release /S /Q && rmdir release /S /Q && del node_modules /S /Q && rmdir node_modules
